I'm Luma Lazarini, an Environmental Studies graduate from UC Santa Barbara (2026) working at the intersection of environmental policy, GIS, and water resources. I've authored a full CEQA/NEPA-compliant Environmental Impact Report, mapped a previously unmapped groundwater aquifer from over 200,000 well records in ArcGIS, and helped verify large-scale environmental datasets for accuracy. I also bring real operations experience — coordinating 60-100 cross-department requests weekly and leading HR for a student team. I'm looking for roles in environmental planning, water resources, or environmental data analysis, based in San Diego, Los Angeles, or open to remote. Outside of work, you'll usually find me at the beach, crocheting, or spending time with friends.
